artworks.title: Les heures du jour
artworks.description: The image features four circular illustrations, each showing a woman in a different setting. In the top left circle, a woman is sitting on an outdoor bench with a parasol. In the top right circle, two women are seated at a table. The bottom left circle shows a woman lounging on a chaise, and the bottom right circle depicts a woman at a writing desk. Each illustration is detailed with a focus on fashion, posture, and surroundings.

artworks.title: Le Bain
artworks.description: The image depicts two women in a room. One woman is seated, partly nude, on an elaborate chair with a cloth covering her lower body. Her hair is styled up with a headdress. The other woman, standing beside her, wears a long red and white dress with puffed sleeves and has her hair styled up with a headpiece. The room is lavishly decorated with a green canopy, patterned walls, a bench with a red draped garment, and a pair of red shoes on the floor. The period design of the room features curved lines and decorative details.

artworks.title: La Toilette
artworks.description: The image shows two women in an indoor setting. One woman is fully naked except for a decorative hat with flowers. The other woman, partially visible from the side, is helping the standing woman. The room contains a mirror, a plush chair with fabric, a side table with a vase of flowers, a clock, and candles. The wall has red-patterned wallpaper and an oval portrait of a man. There is a small fire and an ornate sconce.

artworks.title: Marie-Antoinette, Dauphine
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person displayed from the mid-torso up. The individual faces slightly to the left, with their gaze forward. They have a pale complexion, delicate facial features, and powdered hair styled pulled back. The person wears a garment with a red fur-trimmed collar and a light blue bow at the neckline. No jewelry is visible. The background features an oval frame with decorative leaf motifs on a dark, textured backdrop. An inscription below the oval states the name and title of the person depicted.

artworks.title: L'accident imprevu
artworks.description: The image shows two people, a woman and a young boy, depicted in full-body view. The woman is standing in profile, facing the boy, who is standing directly in front of her. The woman has her hair styled under a large bonnet and is wearing a long dress with long sleeves and a fitted bodice. The boy has short hair and is dressed in a coat with knee-length breeches and stockings, holding a hat in one hand. The room they occupy appears to be a bedroom with a high bed draped with a curtain in the background. There is a table with an iron on a piece of fabric and a chair nearby. The furniture in the room includes a dresser with an open drawer and a cabinet with open doors, revealing a few items on top, including a bust and a bowl. The setting has a window on the right side, allowing light into the room.

artworks.title: The Preparations for the Ballet
artworks.description: The image depicts an indoor scene with multiple individuals in a bustling room. The figures, both men and women, are engaged in various activities such as conversation, dressing, and grooming. The women wear elaborate 18th-century attire with voluminous skirts, bodices, and adorned hats. Some are brushing hair, adjusting clothing, or holding bouquets. The men help the women or adjust their own attire. Women have fashionable updo hairstyles, while men have more subdued styles, with one wearing a necktie. The room is well-lit with large windows and minimal furniture. The background shows a dark wall with hanging garments and a large door to another room. This scene captures a social moment of preparation and leisure, showcasing detailed fashion and lively interactions.

artworks.title: L'assemblee au concert
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an indoor scene featuring individuals gathered for a musical concert. The drawing depicts an opulently decorated room with a domed ceiling adorned with floral designs and classical statues. On the left, three individuals are engaged in conversation, while on the right, musicians are seen preparing for a performance. In the center, an individual is seated at a piano-like instrument. The use of intricate lines and shading techniques highlights the details of the scene.

artworks.title: L'assemblee au salon
artworks.description: This print depicts an opulent interior. The room is richly decorated, with fluted columns, ornate molding under the painted ceiling, and large arched windows. The ceiling features intricate plasterwork and a fresco with cherubs, while a crystal chandelier hangs on the right. Luxurious walls and cushioned furniture with detailed woodwork and embellishments fill the space. Several people are in the room, engaged in different activities. The people all have light skin and curled white or gray hair, and they wear rich, formal clothing such as dresses and suits. Near the bottom left, a woman reads a book by one of the large windows. To the right, a man and a woman sit across a table from one another, and a man stands behind them, looking down at the table. Farther to the right, a man stands over a woman sitting in a chair by a partially visible mantle. In the far right, a group of two men and three women sit and stand around a large table, conversing. On the wooden floor in the center of the print, two small dogs wrestle. Below the print, there is a line of text and a large, ornate shield.

artworks.title: La balancoire mysterieuse
artworks.description: The illustration depicts four individuals in a natural setting near a tree swing. Some are seated while one appears to be operating the swing. The individuals have varying hairstyles and are unclothed. Draped fabric is on the ground, with lush foliage in the background.

artworks.title: Les nymphes scrupuleuses
artworks.description: The image shows three nude figures interacting with a large bust statue of a bearded figure on a pedestal. Two women are standing, one slightly bent over, reaching upwards, while the other stands next to her. The third figure, seated at the base of the statue, has one knee raised and appears to arrange flowers around the pedestal. All three figures have long, flowing hair. Surrounding them are detailed depictions of trees and dense foliage. The scene is framed with an ornate border on each side.

artworks.title: Le Billet doux
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals in an ornate interior setting. In the center, a man interacts with two women. The man is standing, his upper body facing one woman while extending his arm towards the other. He has classic features, pulled back hair, and wears an elaborate coat with breeches and knee-high stockings. The seated woman on the right has styled hair, an updo, and wears a voluminous gown. The woman on the left also wears an elaborate gown and holds a fan or booklet. They wear jewelry. The room has rococo architectural elements, including columns and arches, with a mirror and candelabras in the background. A cello and a piano/harpsichord are visible.

artworks.title: Le Billet doux
artworks.description: The image depicts three individuals in an ornate room. In the center, a man is slightly bent forward, holding the hand of a seated woman on the right. The man has curly, shoulder-length hair tied back and is dressed in a period-style coat, waistcoat, knee breeches, and shoes with buckles. The seated woman has a braided updo adorned with feathers, wearing an elaborately decorated gown among musical instruments. The third individual, another seated woman on the left, is reading a document. She wears a similar period gown with elaborate detail and styled hair. The room features classical architectural elements, such as grand columns and arches, with a highly decorative wall, sconces, and relief sculptures. An elaborate coat of arms flanked by lions is visible in the foreground.

artworks.title: Le Billet doux
artworks.description: The image features three individuals positioned centrally within the composition, shown from head to toe. The central figure is a man standing between two seated women. The man appears to lean towards the woman on the left, who is seated in an ornate high-backed chair and holding a letter or paper. She is elegantly dressed in a lace or embroidered gown with a headpiece or hat, styled hair, and focused on the paper. The man wears an 18th-century formal suit with a long coat, waistcoat, stockings, and buckled shoes, complemented by a tied-back hairstyle. The woman on the right is seated with her feet raised on a box, wearing a layered dress with intricate detailing and a feathered elaborate hairstyle. The setting is a richly adorned room with ornate pillars, archway, detailed moldings and carvings, upholstered furniture, books on a table, and a musical instrument like a cello. The walls showcase classical motifs and a medallion portrait above the figures, reflecting an atmosphere of elegance and opulence typical of 18th-century interiors.

artworks.title: Qu'en dit l'Abbé?
artworks.description: This print features nine individuals in an opulent interior. The people are shown engaging in various poses, including standing, sitting, and leaning. They all have pale skin and elaborate hairstyles of white and gray curls. Their clothing is formal and richly detailed, with the women wearing ornate gowns with ruffles and the men dressed in tailored suits with waistcoats and breeches. To the right of center, a woman lounges in a chair, with two people attending to her, one of them combing her hair. On the left, three people are turned toward her, examining a long sheet of paper or cloth decorated with curving vines. Behind them, two people whisper together on the far left. On the far right, a person sits with their back to us, appearing to work with a stringed instrument like a lute. The setting is an elegant room with a high ceiling adorned with decorative garlands, columns, and draped curtains framing large arched windows. The ceiling features cherubs and intricate molding. In the background, tall doors with classical details can be seen, partially open.

artworks.title: Qu'en dit l'Abbé?
artworks.description: This is a painting of a sophisticated interior scene featuring a social gathering. The image depicts a richly decorated room with ornate architectural features like columns, arches, and intricate moldings on the ceiling. The interior is intricately detailed, capturing the grandeur and opulence of the setting. In the foreground and middle ground, figures in formal attire are engaged in various social interactions. The room is adorned with elegant drapery and furnishings, enhancing the luxurious atmosphere. The use of light and shadow creates depth and emphasizes the elaborate details of the scene.

artworks.title: Colin-maillard
artworks.artist: Louis Le Coeur after Nicolas Lavreince
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals standing outdoors. The first person, a man, is positioned to the left. He has white hair styled in an 18th-century fashion and is wearing a light blue coat with white stockings and dark shoes. A woman stands in the middle, leaning slightly towards the man on her left. She has white hair and is dressed in a white gown with a light blue sash. The third person, another man, stands to the right. He has white hair tied back and is wearing an orange-colored coat over white stockings. In the scene, there are rose bushes, a decorative urn, a large green tree, a tall fountain, foliage, and a lattice structure. At the bottom of the image, a decorative coat of arms is depicted.

artworks.title: La Consolation de l'absence
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated on a fancy couch. She extends one arm towards a small dog nearby. The woman has classical features, styled hair with curls and feathers, and wears an elaborate Rococo-style dress. A small table beside her holds items. The background features a decorated interior with wallpaper or tapestry, an oval frame with a cherubic figure, and a draped curtain. A console table with a vase and statuette is on the side. The setting suggests luxury and classical motifs.

artworks.title: Le contretemps
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals, one sitting on a bed and the other leaning towards them. The person on the bed is partly covered by a blanket and appears to be a male with wavy hair. The standing individual, potentially a female, is wearing a gown with intricate details and a cap. They are holding a document. Another person's face is visible in the background. The room is elegantly decorated with heavy curtains, an ornate picture on the wall, and detailed woodwork. There is a chair with a garment draped over it and a table with a pitcher and items resting on it. The setting suggests a scene from a historical or classical period with a focus on fine furniture and luxurious décor.

artworks.title: Le contretemps
artworks.description: The image shows three people in a room, focusing on a large bed. Two women are visible, one lying in the bed and the other standing beside her. The woman in the bed is propped up by pillows, and the standing woman leans over, with her arm on the bed. Both women have elaborate hairstyles and wear elegant clothing. A man is seen peeking through the curtains and door on the right. The room is decorated with ornate moldings, a plush carpet, a luxurious chair, and a vase on the floor. The setting is lavish and classic.

artworks.title: The Grove
artworks.description: The image displays a scene with two individuals, a man and a woman, shown from their heads to their feet, seated on the ground in a relaxed position. The man sits slightly behind the woman and embraces her from the side, while she leans back against him, her head tilted upwards toward him. The woman's facial features are delicate, with her hair styled in an 18th-century fashion, and she is wearing a garment that appears to be a gown with a low neckline. The man has short hair and a gentle profile, dressed in attire typical of the same period, possibly a coat and breeches. Nearby, there is a pedestal with a sphinx-like statue on top. The background consists of lush foliage and trees, providing a natural setting that surrounds the couple in a circular vignette, which is set against a plain, empty background.

artworks.title: The Green Plot
artworks.description: The image shows two full-bodied figures closely interacting. The male figure is sitting on a rock with one arm wrapped around the female figure who leans against him. She appears to be reclining with her head tilted back. Both figures are dressed in 18th-century style clothing; the male wears a coat, trousers, and shoes with buckles, while the female is dressed in a long, flowing gown with ruffles and lace detailing, and low heeled shoes. Their hair is styled in the manner typical of the period, with the male having wavy hair and the female's hair appearing to be styled upward with curls. The background features a lush, wooded setting with dense foliage, trees, and some carved stone elements.

artworks.title: L'heureux moment
artworks.description: The image shows a man and a woman. The woman is seated on a chaise longue leaning against the armrest, while the man is kneeling beside her, reaching towards her with both arms. The woman's face is turned towards the man. Both individuals have features consistent with classical or 18th-century style, with the woman displaying an elaborate curled hairstyle and wearing a flowing gown that suggests opulence. The man has long hair and is dressed in attire typical of the era. The room is ornately decorated with a richly patterned wallpaper, a heavy drape, and an elaborate frame holding a painting of a cherub surrounded by garlands. Beside the chaise longue, there is a small table with intricate designs. An upholstered chair with elegant detailing is nearby, and further back, a carved room divider adds to the luxury of the setting.

artworks.title: L'heureux moment
artworks.description: The image captures two people, a man kneeling in front of a seated woman. The man is dressed in historical attire and has his hair tied back. The woman wears an elaborate gown and an intricate headpiece. A small dog is on the sofa next to her. The room is ornately decorated with drapery, wall decorations, a pedestal with an urn, and an oval portrait of a cherub surrounded by floral designs. An armchair and a folding screen are in the foreground, with a small table holding a pillow and fabric next to the woman.

artworks.title: L'innocence en danger
artworks.artist: Jean Gabriel Caquet after Nicolas Lavreince
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals in a grand interior setting. In the center, a woman stands elegantly, slightly leaning toward a seated man on the right. She wears elaborate headwear and an 18th-century gown. The man is seated comfortably in an ornate chair with a book in hand. Another woman to the left leans over, dressed in similarly elegant attire. The background features classical architectural elements with columns, arches, and heavy drapery. A table and chair are visible in the left background.
